scope: Separate conditional posterior sensitivity to replacing the existing ACT/Planck and Pan2018 SPT lensing factors with the released Qu ACT/Planck/MUSE joint lensing likelihood; not automatic adoption as the primary measurement.

variant_interpretation.actplanckspt3g_baseline: 35 bins: retain current ACT40-763 window support, replace SPT estimator and use the released joint lensing covariance/precision convention.
variant_interpretation.actplanckspt3g_extended: 38 bins: same replacement plus ACT support to1300, following the Qu paper. Always report separately, never select by favorable outcome.

full_primary_covariance_choice: lens_only=False, likelihood corrections enabled, released no_cmbmarg covariance, indep=False and released global Hartlap precision factor. No additional primary/lensing covariance is supplied.

auxiliary_parameter.name: A_fg
auxiliary_parameter.treatment: Retain normalized source uniform prior in the bridge's extended target. New likelihood independent of A_fg; marginalize/drop only from physical reporting. Do not claim A_fg is measured by the new target.

weight: original exact/proposal log_weight + new_joint_kernel_loglike - old_ACTPlanck_kernel_loglike - old_PanSPT_kernel_loglike; no clipping or smoothing. Fixed normalized-Gaussian constants also recorded, including Hartlap scaling; they cancel normalized posterior weights, not interpreted as evidence.
spectra: One new unchanged native full-source evaluation per selected parent point, raw C_l using FIRASmuK2 for TT/EE/TE/BB and dimensionless potential pp. Both variants reuse this same immutable spectrum. No emulator and no current missing spectral cache assumed.
selection: All points in the qualified parent's frozen exact-correction cohort; preserve original order, independent-chain groups and repeated selections. No likelihood-outcome selection.
qualification: Require measurement_summary.summarize_run to accept the parent before cache/model creation. Use unchanged luminosity-sensitivity-design overlap gates on the final weights, including the auxiliary A_fg diagnostic, every native failure retained. Report each variant only if all gates pass. Finite checks cannot certify unseen modes.

compute.retry: An attempted native point lacking a sealed result is blocked, never silently repeated.

limitations: Released Gaussian MUSE compression differs from full transformed-space MUSE likelihood and contains no delensed EE factor.
Primary-CMB/lensing, lensing/BAO and lensing/SN covariance omissions remain conditional assumptions.
A failed importance bridge requires independent target sampling, not relaxed gates or trimmed weights.
Fixed likelihood normalization offsets compare different data vectors/units and are not a Bayes factor.
Native precision is the parent's declared CAMB accuracy, not a higher-accuracy posterior correction.
